# Limits check (generated by tools/check_limits.py)

Source data: `data/limits_readout_bq_config.csv`. Rsense = 1 mΩ (owner). Decode rules: owner's `docs/Limits_defaults.md` and constants in `bq76952-main/bq76952.cpp` only.

### Thresholds on the chip vs docs/Limits_defaults.md

Delays are shown raw in the CSV (their time units are not defined in the owner's doc). Within-range only shows the current value is legal; it does not prove the range limits themselves.

| Feature | Address | Raw | Decoded | Documented range | In range? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cell overvoltage (COV) | 0x9278 | 0x56 (86) | 4.352 V | 1.012 – 5.566 V (raw 20–110) | yes |
| Cell undervoltage (CUV) | 0x9275 | 0x32 (50) | 2.530 V | 1.012 – 4.048 V (raw 20–80); library allows up to raw 90 = 4.554 V | yes |
| Overcurrent charge (OCC) | 0x9280 | 0x02 (2) | 4 mV = 4 A @1 mΩ | 4 – 124 mV (raw 2–62) | yes |
| Overcurrent discharge 1 (OCD1) | 0x9282 | 0x04 (4) | 8 mV = 8 A @1 mΩ | 4 – 200 mV (raw 2–100) | yes |
| Overcurrent discharge 2 (OCD2) | 0x9284 | 0x03 (3) | 6 mV = 6 A @1 mΩ | 4 – 200 mV (raw 2–100) | yes |
| Short circuit discharge (SCD) | 0x9286 | 0x00 (index 0) | 10 mV = 10 A @1 mΩ | 10 – 500 mV, 16 steps (index 0–15) | yes |
| Overtemp charge (OTC) | 0x929A | 0x37 (55) | 55 °C (signed int8 assumed) | -40 – 120 °C | yes |
| Overtemp discharge (OTD) | 0x929D | 0x3C (60) | 60 °C (signed int8 assumed) | -40 – 120 °C | yes |
| Overtemp internal (OTINT) | 0x92A3 | 0x55 (85) | 85 °C (signed int8 assumed) | -40 – 120 °C | yes |
| Undertemp charge (UTC) | 0x92A6 | 0x00 (0) | 0 °C (signed int8 assumed) | -40 – 120 °C | yes |
| Undertemp discharge (UTD) | 0x92A9 | 0x00 (0) | 0 °C (signed int8 assumed) | -40 – 120 °C | yes |
| Undertemp internal (UTINT) | 0x92AC | 0xEC (-20) | -20 °C (signed int8 assumed) | -40 – 120 °C | yes |
| Overtemp FET (OTF) | 0x92A0 | 0x50 (80) | 80 °C (signed int8 assumed) | 0 – 150 °C | yes |

### Which protections run, what they do to the FETs, what reaches the alarm

'Enabled Protections' = which checks are active. 'DSG/CHG FET Protections' = which faults switch that FET off *when that check is active*. A fault only opens a FET if it is BOTH enabled and listed in that FET's protection register.

| Register | Address | Raw | Bits set (named) | Bit names from |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Enabled Protections A | 0x9261 | 0x88 | SCD, COV | library bit comments (layout assumed same as Safety Status A) |
| Enabled Protections B | 0x9262 | 0x00 | none | library |
| Enabled Protections C | 0x9263 | 0x00 | none | library |
| DSG FET Protections A | 0x9269 | 0xE4 | SCD, OCD2, OCD1, CUV | library |
| DSG FET Protections B | 0x926A | 0xE6 | OTF, OTINT, OTD, UTINT, UTD | library |
| DSG FET Protections C | 0x926B | 0xE2 | OCD3, SCDL, OCDL, HWDF | library |
| CHG FET Protections A | 0x9265 | 0x98 | SCD, OCC, COV | library |
| CHG FET Protections B | 0x9266 | 0xD5 | OTF, OTINT, OTC, UTINT, UTC | library (bits partly undocumented) |
| CHG FET Protections C | 0x9267 | 0x56 | SCDL, HWDF | library (bits partly undocumented) |
| SF Alert Mask A | 0x926F | 0xFC | SCD, OCD2, OCD1, OCC, COV, CUV | library |
| SF Alert Mask B | 0x9270 | 0xF7 | OTF, OTINT, OTD, OTC, UTINT, UTD, UTC | library |
| SF Alert Mask C | 0x9271 | 0xF4 | OCD3, SCDL, OCDL | library |
